description:
## Goal

Make ProductMemo the sole authority for settled materialized, ABI, backend, and executable-index products and delete their parallel typed inventories from PullSession.

## Evidence

PullSession stores materialized, ABI, backend, and executable-index maps in parallel with the memo. Producers clone values into these side maps. Most reads are inventory or tests; typed iteration over settled memo keys and values can answer the same questions. ExecutableEffects side storage is deliberately out of scope and is removed by fz-tfn.8 with its private effect graph.

## Strategy and proof

1. After reactive effects and shared payloads land, inventory every remaining side-map producer and consumer and classify the semantic question it asks.
2. Add typed memo iteration/query APIs only for live questions.
3. Move production consumers and assertions to memo-owned products.
4. Prove identical materialized activation set, executable index, settled-key set, product generations, root artifact, and telemetry.
5. Delete materialized_executables, abi_executables, backend_executables, executable_index, record APIs, invalidation code made unreachable, and transition-only tests.
6. Run full product tests, library, fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied.

No compatibility mirror remains.
title: Delete PullSession's parallel artifact side maps
